title: Crisis Response Simulator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners make four decisions in a data breach crisis and hear the press statement their choices produce, with each crisis-communication principle marked as met or missed.

learningObjectives: Respond to a crisis scenario by selecting appropriate crisis storytelling elements (acknowledgment, transparency, accountability, solution-focus) and avoiding defensive behaviors.
prerequisites: Story Crisis Response and Story Reputation Management sections of Chapter 13

keyQuestions: Respond to a crisis scenario by selecting appropriate crisis storytelling elements (acknowledgment, transparency, accountability, solution-focus) and avoiding defensive behaviors.
commonMisconceptions: Speed is less important than accuracy.
assessmentOpportunities: All four decisions follow the recommended principles.
Learner can explain why "blame hackers" damages trust even when it is true.
